1.title: 概覽
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特很可能是《鬥陣特攻》中唯一受到大眾喜愛的英雄。每當出現萊因哈特強勢的環境時，社群通常都會對平衡狀態感到滿意。作為最初的英雄之一，他以第一人稱射擊遊戲中少見的護盾與近戰英雄定位，定義了這款遊戲。他所有的戰術規劃都圍繞著他的護盾與戰鎚展開，其餘技能則是用來輔助這兩項核心能力。

如果你是回歸《鬥陣特攻》的玩家或是新手，在主要的 5v5 模式中，每隊僅有一名坦克，這大幅改變了 ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特的遊玩風格。在遊戲初期，常見的術語是「主坦」與「副坦」。基本上，擁有護盾的 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克英雄被視為「主坦」，而像 ![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)攔路豬這種沒有護盾的英雄則被視為「副坦」。

如今，![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特的工作不再只是站在前線抵擋傷害。現在他的職責包含擔任前線、佔領據點、衝鋒陷陣突襲敵方後排，並且經常在隊伍中擔任輸出主力。

1.1.1.title: 操作指南
content: * 使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/1858a99948e6d377.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrier-shield.png)屏障力場和 ![](/data/assets/guide/acd524155a25802e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcharge.png)衝鋒作為重新定位的工具。同時利用這兩項技能來佔據空間，並讓自己接近至近戰範圍。

* 在掩體後方啟動 ![](/data/assets/guide/d2aabba10a98f146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffire-strike.png)烈焰擊，並在發射的瞬間探頭，以將受到的傷害降至最低。

* 在使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/7d8540657f6fd9b7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fearthshatter.png)地裂擊之前，請確認你的 ![](/data/assets/guide/d2aabba10a98f146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffire-strike.png)烈焰擊充能次數以及隊友的位置，以免擊倒敵方隊伍後，卻沒有後續手段來真正擊殺任何一名敵人。

1.1.2.title: 對戰策略
content: * 利用暈眩與擊退效果來阻止他的進攻。如果他無法進入 ![](/data/assets/guide/0bdc6b49a56a3be7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-hammer.png)火箭鎚的攻擊範圍，他的威脅性將會大幅降低。
* 從側邊角度消耗他的屏障，而不是聚集在他的正面，那樣只會讓他的隊友能安全地攻擊你們。

* 當你看到敵方萊因哈特走位異常靠前時，要提防 ![](/data/assets/guide/7d8540657f6fd9b7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fearthshatter.png)裂地重擊。一旦看到他放下屏障並開始蓄力，請立即使用你的屏障或位移技能進行規避。

2.title: 優勢與劣勢總結
content: * 佔據空間
* 範圍傷害（AoE damage）
* 傷害減免（Damage mitigation）
* 必須在輸出傷害或減免傷害之間做出選擇
* 射程較短
* 缺乏垂直機動性

3.1.1.title: 佔據空間
content: 佔據並控制空間是坦克的主要職責之一，而這正是 ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特最擅長的地方。當這位揮舞著巨錘的力量型角色帶著隊伍走在巨大的屏障後方時，敵方將會發現極難阻擋他的推進。敵隊並不希望萊因哈特靠近，所以當他向前推進時，他們只能被迫後退。而在防守時，任何想要向前推進的敵方英雄，都必須自願進入萊因哈特的最佳攻擊範圍，也就是他能夠揮動 ![](/data/assets/guide/0bdc6b49a56a3be7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-hammer.png)火箭錘（Rocket Hammer）擊中目標的距離。

3.1.2.title: 範圍傷害
content: 針對那些喜歡將多名隊員聚集在一起的敵方隊伍，他錘子的巨大範圍傷害判定能造成極高的擴散傷害。一次揮擊命中三名敵人並不罕見，這會導致每秒造成約 300 點傷害！此外，![](/data/assets/guide/d2aabba10a98f146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffire-strike.png)烈焰擊（Fire Strike）投射物擁有很長的判定範圍且能穿透敵人，進一步提升了萊因哈特在面對聚集敵人時的威力。

3.1.3.title: 傷害減免
content: 傷害減免在《鬥陣特攻》中非常重要，甚至在遊戲內的計分板上有專屬的欄位。沒有其他坦克能跟上萊因哈特（Reinhardt）所能提供的驚人傷害減免量 ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)。擁有一個沒有冷卻時間的護盾，使他能夠針對敵方的核心冷卻技能與絕招進行反應式格擋。![](/data/assets/guide/e2b61a19c451876c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrier-field.png)屏障力場（Barrier Field）在每一次的交鋒中都對萊因哈特有利。他只需要犧牲一點護盾生命值，就能完全抵銷敵方冷卻時間長達 10 秒以上的技能。

他的護盾也是目前所有護盾中生命值最高的，且在未部署幾秒後會自動恢復生命值。![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特（Reinhardt）的高額護盾生命值，讓他能在戰鬥中生命值偏低時，透過單純不收起護盾的方式來觸發被動效果。

3.2.1.title: 必須在造成傷害與減輕傷害之間做出選擇

![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)席格馬 或 ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎 這類坦克時，他們會佔有優勢，因為他們可以在對 必須不斷地在 100% 防禦或 100% 進攻之間做出選擇。

3.2.2.title: 遠程傷害不足
content: 最後兩個最嚴重的弱點是身為近戰英雄，且缺乏任何垂直移動能力。雖然 ![](/data/assets/guide/d2aabba10a98f146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffire-strike.png)烈焰擊（Fire Strike）確實算是一種遠程技能，但其冷卻時間過長且飛行速度緩慢，導致在實際遠距離使用時並不可靠。在視野開闊的地圖區域，萊因哈特往往必須耗盡所有護盾生命值，才能緩慢地嘗試進入近戰範圍，這讓他幾乎沒有剩餘護盾可用於激進打法，或是在生命值偏低時保護自己。鬥陣特攻中的大多數英雄都能在萊因哈特的近戰範圍外進行轉位，並持續輸出傷害而無需擔心受到反擊。

3.2.3.title: 缺乏垂直機動性
content: 在擁有大量高處地形的地圖或目標點上，萊因哈特可能會顯得相當無用，因為他沒有任何方式可以爭奪高處或進行垂直移動。在這些情況下，最好的做法通常是單純為隊友舉盾，並祈禱他們能擊殺敵人。唯一的其他選擇是繞遠路前往高處區域，或是利用隊友的技能，例如 ![](/data/assets/guide/41367de8021167d5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flifeweaver.png)織命 ![](/data/assets/guide/d747d16d3747ce4f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpetal-platform.png)花瓣平台來移動他。無論如何，萊因哈特都沒有手段在高處與低處之間來回移動，這讓擁有機動性的敵人能輕易避開他。

4.1.title: 主要攻擊：火箭槌
content: 揮舞巨大的槌子進行橫向弧形攻擊。

![](/data/assets/guide/0bdc6b49a56a3be7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-hammer.png)火箭槌的使用技巧
* 傷害並可穿透護盾技能。
* 第一次揮擊永遠是從右向左，之後會持續來回揮動，直到放開主要攻擊鍵為止。
* 判定框為矩形。最遠攻擊距離位於左右兩側 45 度的角落。

* 揮動時稍微傾斜或快速左右擺動準心，可將![](/data/assets/guide/0bdc6b49a56a3be7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-hammer.png)火箭槌的傷害判定範圍向前延伸。
* 盡可能嘗試在單次揮擊中同時擊中多名敵人。
* 在掩體後方開始揮擊動畫，並在判定框即將接觸敵人時踏入空曠處，以減少攻擊時受到的傷害。

4.2.title: 次要攻擊：屏障力場
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特會在身前舉起一面大型矩形護盾，用以吸收所有投射物與爆炸傷害。

**![](/data/assets/guide/e2b61a19c451876c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrier-field.png)屏障力場使用技巧**
* 護盾在停止使用 2 秒後會開始恢復生命值。
* 當護盾生命值偏低時，請利用掩體或隊伍治療來爭取護盾恢復的時間。

* 當 ![](/data/assets/guide/e2b61a19c451876c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrier-field.png)屏障力場部署時，萊因哈特的移動速度會降低 30%。
* 「護盾跳躍（Shield Hopping）」是指在全速奔跑時跳躍，在空中舉起護盾，落地時收起護盾，這樣能在維持 100% 移動速度的同時，穿插進行部分傷害減免。
* 一般來說，當護盾破損（低於 700 生命值）時進行激進的打法是不安全的。
* 最顯而易見的用途是抵擋隨機傷害與遠程消耗。
* 最好的用法是透過短暫閃現護盾，直接阻擋敵方隊伍的高價值冷卻技能。

* 例如：透過移動、站位與時機誘騙出 ![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)攔路豬 的「肉鉤」，然後在敵方鉤子射出的瞬間舉盾格擋。萊因哈特隨後有 6 秒的時間可以更安全地進行攻擊。

* 護盾底部必須與地面接觸，才能阻擋像 ![](/data/assets/guide/7d8540657f6fd9b7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fearthshatter.png)地裂擊 這類技能。

* 同時按住 ![](/data/assets/guide/e2b61a19c451876c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrier-field.png)屏障力場 與 ![](/data/assets/guide/0bdc6b49a56a3be7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-hammer.png)火箭鎚，即可在舉盾時切換至第三人稱視角自由觀察。
* 這對於查看身後隊友的站位很有幫助。
* 也可以用來探查轉角處的情況。

4.3.title: [E]：烈焰擊（Fire Strike）
content: 蓄力後揮動戰鎚，射出一道會穿透敵人與護盾的烈焰投射物。

![](/data/assets/guide/d2aabba10a98f146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffire-strike.png)烈焰擊（Fire Strike）的使用技巧

* 可以透過動畫取消將戰鎚揮擊轉為 ![](/data/assets/guide/d2aabba10a98f146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffire-strike.png)烈焰擊（Fire Strike），以造成爆發傷害。

* 緩慢的起手與收招動畫會讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特（Reinhardt）容易受到傷害與控場技能的影響。

* 最好的方式是先在掩體後方開始動作，在射出 ![](/data/assets/guide/d2aabba10a98f146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffire-strike.png)烈焰擊（Fire Strike）的瞬間跨出掩體，並在收招動畫期間退回掩體後方。
* 務必嘗試在單次使用中擊中多個目標。
* 非常適合用來收掉試圖逃跑或退回掩體後方的敵人。

4.4.title: [SHIFT]：衝鋒
content: 在地面上以高速直線向前衝鋒 3 秒。
![](/data/assets/guide/acd524155a25802e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcharge.png)衝鋒的技巧
* 可以進行微幅的左右移動控制。
* 按下 SHIFT 鍵可隨時取消。
* 將敵人帶到地圖邊緣後取消，可將他們撞飛出地圖外。
* 取消並按住跳躍鍵，可將慣性帶入空中。
* 跳躍取消加上按住揮擊（Swing），可在衝鋒結束後快速發動攻擊。
* 與其說是為了釘住目標，更多時候是用於機動性或拉近與敵人的距離。

4.5.title: [Q]：（絕招）裂地重擊
content: 關於 ![](/data/assets/guide/7d8540657f6fd9b7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fearthshatter.png)裂地重擊的提示

* 大多數的坦克英雄都擁有可以格擋裂地重擊的能力，例如 ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)堅毅、![](/data/assets/guide/921f50ca3ecba070.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrier-array.png)防禦矩陣，以及 ![](/data/assets/guide/81b1062b5b25f966.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fparticle-barrier.png)粒子屏障，或是透過像 ![](/data/assets/guide/390fb173c801c718.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fboosters.png)推進器和 ![](/data/assets/guide/71e72edd3dddab12.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjump-pack.png)噴射跳躍這類升空技能來避開重擊。

* 身為 ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特，你的職責是追蹤敵方坦克何時擁有這些技能，以及它們何時處於冷卻狀態。
* 一般來說，你應該保留你的絕招，直到看見對方使用過這些技能後再施放，以提高裂地重擊的成功率。
* 單殺重擊（Solo-shatter）也能帶來極高的價值。
* 你不需要每次都擊倒 5 個人才能靠絕招贏得會戰。

* 與其擊倒他的 4 名隊友卻讓他使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/feb976c891fbe2ae.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftranscendence.png)超凡入聖來保住所有人，不如直接單殺重擊並消滅敵方的 ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)禪亞塔來得更好。

5.1.1.title: 十字軍之火
5.1.1.description: 當你擊暈敵人時，返還一次烈焰擊（Fire Strike）充能，最多可累積至 3 次。
content: * 確保你在使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/7d8540657f6fd9b7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fearthshatter.png)地裂擊（Earthshatter）後，擁有 ![](/data/assets/guide/d2aabba10a98f146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffire-strike.png)烈焰擊（Fire Strike）可以進行後續追擊。
* 標準 250 生命值的英雄可以被地裂擊 > 烈焰擊（x2）擊殺，因此這項特殊能力（perk）能讓你的地裂擊更具致命性。

5.1.2.title: 十字軍決心
5.1.2.description: 當使用屏障力場（Barrier Field）時，你的被動生命恢復觸發速度加快 75%。
content: * 在被迫採取較被動打法的對局中表現良好，例如面對 ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎 或 ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)莫加 時。
* 如果你的支援角治療輸出較低，這也是一個不錯的選擇。

5.2.1.title: 盾擊（Shield Slam）
5.2.1.description: 當屏障力場（Barrier Field）啟動時，使用主要攻擊來對敵人造成傷害並將其擊退。
content: * 失去按住次要攻擊並在不旋轉視角的情況下環顧四周的能力。
* 盾擊本身尚可，但通常不值得為了它而放棄增加攻擊速度的選擇。

5.2.2.title: 烈焰之怒
5.2.2.description: 每擊中一名敵人，烈焰擊（Fire Strike）便會使你的攻擊速度提升 25%，持續 2 秒。
content: * 至少保留一個 ![](/data/assets/guide/d2aabba10a98f146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffire-strike.png)烈焰擊（Fire Strike）以備進入近戰範圍時使用。提升的攻擊速度在近距離纏鬥中非常強大，將有助於你贏得 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)坦克對決。

6.1.1.title: 國王大道
content: * 國王大道的第一場會戰幾乎總是發生在佔領點與攻擊方重生點之間的隘口。防守此區域時，通常會選擇一名護盾坦克。護盾幾乎可以阻擋《鬥陣特攻》中所有類型的傷害，但 ![](/data/assets/guide/0bdc6b49a56a3be7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-hammer.png)火箭槌與 ![](/data/assets/guide/d2aabba10a98f146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffire-strike.png)烈焰擊能讓萊因哈特穿透護盾造成傷害。隊伍會戰通常會被迫在運載目標上進行，萊因哈特可以在地圖各處利用運載目標作為掩體，甚至能安全地從其後方發動 ![](/data/assets/guide/7d8540657f6fd9b7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fearthshatter.png)地裂擊。

6.1.2.title: 愛西瓦德
content: * 萊因哈特在愛西瓦德的第一個和第三個據點強得離譜，在第二個據點也能找到發揮作用的創意打法。在防守時，利用錘子、![](/data/assets/guide/d2aabba10a98f146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffire-strike.png)烈焰擊和![](/data/assets/guide/e2b61a19c451876c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrier-field.png)屏障力場可以完全掌控隘口，並決定進攻隊伍能做什麼。基本上，只要在第一個據點不陣亡，即使敵方隊伍擊殺了其他隊友，他們也無法贏得會戰。

6.1.3.title: 灕江天塔
content: * 水平移動能力與平坦地形的控制力是 ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特最大的優勢。灕江天塔的三個據點幾乎完全平坦。萊因哈特可以步行前往任何地方，或是使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/acd524155a25802e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcharge.png)衝鋒（Charge）來快速橫越控制區域。敵方隊伍至少會有一名英雄在據點內，這意味著你的鐵鎚永遠會有目標可以敲擊！

6.2.1.title: 多拉多
content: * 在多拉多進行遊戲時，萊因哈特除了待在護送目標旁之外，幾乎無計可施。防守方會樂見他待在那裡，同時對他的整個隊伍傾瀉火力，最終贏得會戰，並看著護送目標緩慢地退回起點。在防守時，你要麼與隊友一起在高處擔任護盾機器人，要麼就將自己置於非常危險的位置，試圖強行發起正面對決。

6.2.2.title: 皇家賽道
content: * ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)席格馬。萊因哈特在皇家賽道表現掙扎的主要原因，在於![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)席格馬的技能組與這張地圖的契合度實在太完美了。你幾乎可以肯定在進入揮擊範圍前，護盾就會先被打破。如果你成功推進到最後一個據點，由於敵方陣型過於分散，萊因哈特只要試圖採取行動，就會從四面八方遭到猛烈攻擊。

6.2.3.title: 伊利歐斯：水井
content: * 在地圖中央設置一個巨大的坑洞，將兩側隔開，這正是身披重甲的騎士的致命弱點。這口水井是敵人用來與他玩「繞圈圈」遊戲，並永久保持在近戰範圍之外的絕佳工具。此外，萊因哈特很容易受到擊退技能的影響，被撞進坑洞之中。

7.title: 隊伍陣容搭配
content: 萊因哈特最適合在全隊共同推進的「衝鋒（Rush）」風格陣容中發揮。其他擅長近距離纏鬥的傷害型英雄，例如 ![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)小美和 ![](/data/assets/guide/5bcf0662f0357e81.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freaper.png)死神，能與萊因哈特產生強大的搭配效果；此外，隊伍中若有遠程英雄和側襲者也能彌補他的弱點。
**兩種以萊因哈特為核心的隊伍陣容：**

* 所有隊員緊密集結在他身邊，並強勢壓制敵方隊伍。
**範例**：[[__OWH_IMG_1__]]萊因哈特、[[__OWH_IMG_2__]]小美、[[__OWH_IMG_3__]]卡西迪、[[__OWH_IMG_4__]]路西歐、[[__OWH_IMG_5__]]莫伊拉

* 隊友採取行動以彌補萊因哈特在射程與高地壓制力上的弱點。
**範例**：![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特、![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)艾西、![](/data/assets/guide/e57835c9ff2eb7ae.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fcassidy.png)閃光、![](/data/assets/guide/3d1103aaa0893433.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flucio.png)安娜、![](/data/assets/guide/d2383fba0420b5f1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmoira.png)霧子
2. Teammates play to make up for Rein’s weaknesses such as range and high ground pressure.

**Example**: ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)Reinhardt, ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)Ashe, ![](/data/assets/guide/5c24a105db5a970e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftracer.png)Tracer, ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)Ana, ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)Kiriko

7.1.1.title: 輸出型英雄
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)小美

* ![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)小美與萊因哈特的技能組是完美的正面戰場搭檔。![](/data/assets/guide/f6754797bf4c1a57.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fice-wall.png)冰牆（Ice Wall）可以用於進攻，將敵方前線與其隊伍隔開，讓萊因哈特能夠在不受敵方後排遠程技能威脅的情況下自由揮舞。![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)小美也可以利用![](/data/assets/guide/f6754797bf4c1a57.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fice-wall.png)冰牆（Ice Wall）進行防禦，以拯救她的萊因哈特，或是讓隊伍能安全通過開闊區域。
![](/data/assets/guide/85db567c48780d42.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsymmetra.png)辛梅塔

* ![](/data/assets/guide/dfca9f5b755d9b41.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fphoton-projector.png)光子投射器（Photon Projector）需要時間充能才能達到最大傷害，且射程也相當短。這兩項特性都能從萊因哈特的護盾持續貼近敵方隊伍中獲得巨大優勢。辛梅塔與萊因哈特同時攻擊同一個目標時，具有極高的傷害潛力。此外，將![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特傳送至高處或敵方後方，往往能迅速贏得會戰。

7.1.2.title: 支援
content:
**路西歐**
* 速度增益，這是萊因哈特所能獲得最棒的能力。[[__OWH_IMG_1__]]路西歐的速度基本上彌補了[[__OWH_IMG_2__]]萊因哈特的所有弱點。如果敵方沒有強大的位移能力，且沒有自己的[[__OWH_IMG_4__]]路西歐來加速逃離，他們就會被[[__OWH_IMG_3__]]路西歐與萊因哈特的組合徹底輾壓。萊因哈特只需要更好地管理護盾與生命值，就能把握機會衝鋒擊潰脆弱的敵人。

* Speed Boost, the #1 greatest ability Rein could ever be given. ![](/data/assets/guide/3d1103aaa0893433.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flucio.png)Lúcio speed basically makes up for every one of ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)Reinhardt's weaknesses. Enemies without strong movement abilities get completely ran over by ![](/data/assets/guide/3d1103aaa0893433.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flucio.png)Lúcio + Rein if they don’t have a ![](/data/assets/guide/3d1103aaa0893433.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flucio.png)Lúcio of their own to speed away. Rein just needs to better manage his shield and hp to capitalize on opportunities to rush down vulnerable enemies.

**Not** ![](/data/assets/guide/df34545acaf615da.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbrigitte.png)Brigitte

* Pro Tip: Contrary to what a decent amount of the player base seems to believe, Brig is one of the worst supports to play with and against ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)Reinhardt. She doesn’t provide enough healing for Rein to play aggressively, and ![](/data/assets/guide/7a4683cc8d893758.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwhip-shot.png)Whip Shot boops people away from Rein which he does not want, and the OW iteration of Brig is not tanky enough to stay front line with her tank.
* Bonus tip: She also sucks against Rein because if she gets in range for her melee, she gets deleted.

* 追蹤敵方 ![](/data/assets/guide/7d8540657f6fd9b7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fearthshatter.png)地裂擊（Earthshatter）絕招充能進度非常重要。

* 如果雙方隊伍都有 ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)安娜，能夠格擋 ![](/data/assets/guide/89ddbbfe1fbc9a6c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsleep-dart.png)睡眠鏢（Sleep Dart）的萊因哈特將會贏得鏡像對決。

8.0.2.title: 坦克
content:
![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)歐瑞莎
* ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)標槍旋轉（Javelin Spin）、標槍投擲（Energy Javelin）以及 [[__OWH_IMG_2__]]強化防禦（Fortify）看起來就像是專門為了反制萊因哈特的技能組而設計的。萊因哈特永遠無法越過 [[__OWH_IMG_3__]]歐瑞莎，因為她可以隨心所欲地將他推來推去。他無法在正面戰場與她對抗，因為 [[__OWH_IMG_4__]]強化防禦能減免過多傷害，同時還能對萊因哈特巨大的頭部判定範圍造成暴擊。如果 [[__OWH_IMG_5__]]歐瑞莎夠聰明，她根本不會進入 [[__OWH_IMG_6__]]火箭鎚（Rocket Hammer）的攻擊範圍，這讓戰鬥變成一面倒的局面。

* ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)Javelin Spin, Throw, and ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)Fortify seem like they were specifically designed to counter Rein’s kit. Rein can’t ever walk past ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa as she can freely move him around wherever she sees fit. He can’t front line battle her as ![](/data/assets/guide/1818b49db97673b3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffortify.png)Fortify mitigates too much damage while critical hitting Rein’s big head hitbox. If the ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa is smart, she is almost never in range of ![](/data/assets/guide/0bdc6b49a56a3be7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-hammer.png)Rocket Hammer anyway making it a one sided battle.
![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)Roadhog

* The armor rework has made this match up more manageable for ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)Reinhardt. Nevertheless, all Hog has to do to win the fight is land one hook on Rein and yank him around the corner into his trap. Rein has to block every single hook and hope he can slowly win the fight by taking advantage of the enemies lack of shield.

8.0.3.title: 輸出角色（DPS）
content: * ![](/data/assets/guide/98529ba32956dcb8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fpharah.png)法拉：簡單來說，你幾乎無法對抗 ![](/data/assets/guide/98529ba32956dcb8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fpharah.png)法拉的飛行。就算你偶爾能用火擊對空中的目標造成傷害，那也不過是她不到一半的生命值，根本無濟於事。盡可能格擋掉你能擋下的火箭，並祈禱你的隊友能將她擊落。萊因哈特能做的最好策略，就是對敵方剩餘隊伍施加足夠的壓力和傷害，讓敵方支援無法將資源分配給 [[__OWH_IMG_2__]]法拉，這樣你的隊友就能更容易地解決她。

* ![](/data/assets/guide/98529ba32956dcb8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fpharah.png)小美：正如 ![](/data/assets/guide/98529ba32956dcb8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fpharah.png)小美的 ![](/data/assets/guide/98529ba32956dcb8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fpharah.png)冰牆（Ice Wall）是協助萊因哈特的完美工具，它同時也是讓萊因哈特徹底無用的完美工具。一旦被冰牆隔開，即便護盾生命值全滿，萊因哈特也很難存活。應對方式是嘗試利用你的時機與進場方式來誘騙 [[__OWH_IMG_3__]]小美，讓她浪費冰牆，接著在她技能冷卻期間轉為激進打法。
![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)Mei

* Just as ![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)Mei's ![](/data/assets/guide/f6754797bf4c1a57.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fice-wall.png)Ice Wall is the perfect tool to help Rein, it’s also the perfect tool to make him completely useless. When walled off, Rein will rarely live even with a full HP shield. The play is to try and trick the ![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)Mei with your timing and approach, making her waste wall, then going aggro during its cooldown.

8.0.4.title: 支援
content:
![](/data/assets/guide/3d1103aaa0893433.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flucio.png)路西歐
* 無論萊因哈特多努力想要追擊敵人，![](/data/assets/guide/3d1103aaa0893433.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flucio.png)路西歐都能透過加速增幅讓所有人脫離他的攻擊範圍。[[__OWH_IMG_2__]]路西歐的音波也能在隊友被你逼近時救下他們，或是干擾[[__OWH_IMG_3__]]衝鋒的軌跡。他的遠程傷害對於消耗[[__OWH_IMG_4__]]屏障力場也相當有價值。
